newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firmer on Tuesday, traders said.
Gas oil firmed 75 cents on a cold-inspired rise in futures. Barge premiums rose 50 cents on delivery delays due to ice.
Gasoline was steady to soft with European demand thin but U.S. buying supportive. Prompt barges traded $221/$220 fob ARA.
Naphtha held steady in a wide range with buyers relaxed and offers scarce. Cargo bids were around $216 with offers at $220.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil was steady as the market's main seller in recent days sold two more pieces at $113 fob ARA.
